caseNameFull: Gottschalk, Acting Commissioner of Patents v. Benson
judges: Black, Consideration, Motion, Mun, Stewart, Took

opinions.text:
C. C. P. A. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 915.] Motion of petitioner to dispense with printing appendix and to proceed on original record granted.

Mr. Justice Stewart, Mr. Justice Black-mun, and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
